english.title: Urinate in a street / public place in contravention of a byelaw
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in a street or public place, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..),

(A)_[to the annoyance of residents or passengers committed an act of indecency by urinating within their view]_
(B)_[committed an indecent act by urinating]_

in contravention of a byelaw, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BYELAW..)
english.legislation: Contrary to the above byelaw and sections 235 and 237 of the Local Government Act 1972.
